positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Enhanced a major company product by developing and testing application features
- Collaborated closely with product team and customers, data science and business analysis teams, to develop and test essential internal development tools.
- Worked with the product development team as a returning intern: contributed to iteration planning, feature design, and implementation development, and practiced pair-programming with full-time engineers

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
- Worked in the product and infrastructure development team: contributed to team iteration planning and collaborated with full-time engineers
- Deployed a major company product on the cloud for a prospective client
- Accelerated the existing release-promotion method by implementing an automatic release version management system
- Developed and enhanced product software by implementing and testing multiple features, such as multipurpose parsers

projects.title: Fisheries Data Collection System
projects.description: A collaboration project with the marines sciences research program at Cal Poly. The final product is an electronic solution that will be used by California Collaborative Fisheries Research Program(CCFRP) to record fish data in marine protected areas and associated reference sites.
